newsitem.title: JAPAN: N.Korea slams Russia on report of arms deal.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea slams Russia on report of arms deal.

text.p: North Korea condemned its one-time close ally Russia on Friday for a reported plan to sell missiles to South Korea, saying the move was likely to raise tension on the Korean peninsula.
"We cannot overlook the arms deal because it may gravely affect the already tense situation of the Korean peninsula," a North Korean Foreign Ministry spokesman said.

"The export of sophisticated weapons to South Korea cannot be construed otherwise but an act of encouraging the South Korean authorities, who have been intentionally deteriorating inter-Korean relations, to the provocation of a war," he said.
The spokesman's remarks were carried by North Korea's official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA), monitored in Tokyo.
"If arms sale to South Korea is left tolerated, it will result in impeding all the proposals and efforts for the peace and stability of the Korean Peninsula," the spokesman said.
Media reports have recently said Russia may sell a new anti-aircraft missile system to South Korea.
Although the Korean War ended in 1953, North and South Korea remain technically at war.
